content_sections.heading: GIMS Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential qualification, age and experience for all posts are as per National Medical Commission (NMC) Guidelines . A summary of the key requirements from the notification is given below. For super-specialty subjects, candidates require D.M./DNB/DrNB or M.Ch/DNB/DrNB in the concerned super specialty, with experience as Assistant/Associate Professor in the subject and completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research, as detailed in the official notification. Alternate qualification routes during the transition period apply for Critical Care Medicine and Medical Oncology as specified in the notification. Retired Professors/Faculty from Government institutes and Defence Personnel may apply for the post of Professor, as per NMC Guidelines.

content_sections.heading: GIMS Faculty Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: This is a contractual faculty appointment; there is no written examination. Selection is based on scrutiny of qualifications, experience and publications, followed by a personal interview. Screening/shortlisting of applications based on the essential academic qualification and experience prescribed for each post as per NMC Guidelines. Shortlisted candidates are called for a Personal Interview at GIMS, Greater Noida. Candidates who have applied in advance may submit their No Objection Certificate (NOC)/forwarding letter from their current employer up to the date of the interview. The Director, GIMS reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. Exact interview date, venue, and further stages (if any) are not specified in the official notification and will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GIMS Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Applications submitted by hand will not be entertained. Incomplete applications will be treated as cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of Birth certificate (as per Matriculation certificate) Certificates of academic qualifications, mark sheets, degrees, and official transcripts from each institution attended (with certified English/Hindi translation, if required) Complete teaching and other experience certificates Reprints of up to 5 best original research publications, as per NMC regulations Certificates of distinctions, prizes, medals, etc. SC/ST/OBC category certificate from a competent authority, issued not earlier than 6 months before the last date of application No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer Self-declaration certifying correctness of entries in the application Demand draft/fee payment proof (scanned copy)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be considered and will be treated as cancelled. Advance applications are accepted, but a forwarding copy through proper channel or an NOC from the current employer must be submitted before the date of interview. The number of posts is provisional and subject to change without prior notice; selection may not be held for all advertised posts. Reservation and age relaxation for reserved-category candidates apply as per Uttar Pradesh Government rules. The Director, GIMS reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, UP. For queries: Fee-related – 9891636435; Experience/Age/Qualification-related – 8860997164; General – 0120-2341738 / 9999384468, [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty posts has GIMS Greater Noida notified in 2026?
faq.answer: GIMS has notified 63 contractual posts – 15 Professor, 17 Associate Professor and 31 Assistant Professor – across 20 departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GIMS Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification lists different dates in different versions – 17 September 2026, 19 September 2026, and 18 September 2026 (5:00 PM) appear across the document. Candidates should verify the current date on www.gims.ac.in.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a written exam for GIMS faculty posts?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on scrutiny of qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for GIMS Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: ₹2,20,000/- for Professor, ₹1,60,000/- for Associate Professor, and ₹1,20,000/- for Assistant Professor, per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for GIMS faculty posts?
faq.answer: Qualification and experience are as per NMC Guidelines, generally an MD/MS/DNB (or equivalent) in the concerned subject with the prescribed teaching experience for each designation.

faq.question: Q6. Can retired professors apply for GIMS Professor posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Professors/Faculty from Government institutes and Defence Personnel may apply for the post of Professor, as per NMC Guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is the application process online or offline for GIMS faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Both – candidates must apply online first, then send a printout of the application with self-attested documents by registered/speed post.
